name: Zhou Yong
current_role: Founder (described as CTO/CEO in different sources), Linkerbot (灵心巧手), Beijing
profile: Zhou Yong (Alex Zhou) founded Linkerbot in 2023 to build low-cost, high-degree-of-freedom dexterous robotic hands (Linker Hand series) for humanoid robots and industry. Linkerbot claims >80% of the global high-DoF robotic-hand market by volume and was valued at ~US$3bn in an April 2026 round, with later reports of a ~$6bn raise.
interesting_fact: Before robotics he spent about a decade in global online communities; his previous company reached ~300 million users, less than 1% of them in China. He says: 'The hand is the last great hardware problem in robotics.'
deep_cut_fact: He graduated from the Youth Class (gifted-teen program) at Huazhong University of Science and Technology at age 14; he set out to build a hand that beats the UK Shadow Hand at a fraction of the price.
notes: Goes by Alex Zhou in English media (WIRED, Pandaily). Titles vary across sources (founder & CTO vs CEO). Very on-topic for a tech/hardware podcast; company is actively fundraising and media-facing.

name: Lu Xiaowei
profile: Listed by Hurun (China 2020-2026, Global 2026) with ~US$940m attributed to Nongfu Spring. No public source found identifying Lu Xiaowei (卢晓苇) as a Nongfu Spring director, executive or named substantial shareholder; the stake is likely held indirectly via a pre-IPO shareholding vehicle.
notes: Not found on Nongfu Spring's 2024-2026 board lists (HKEX filings) or in English/Chinese press. Extremely low public profile; possibly an early/indirect shareholder. name: Chatchai Kaewbootta
current_role: CEO and Director, Srisawad Corporation PCL (SET: SAWAD), Thailand
profile: Chatchai Kaewbootta built Srisawad into one of Thailand's largest lenders against motorcycles, cars and homes (5,500+ branches, plus nano-finance). The son of a tractor distributor, he became a Honda motorcycle dealer, started the lending business in 1984, sold it to AIG in 2007 and re-entered the market under a new name in 2009. He dropped off Forbes' billionaire list after 2023.
interesting_fact: He named the company after his mother; its slogan 'Mee Baan Mee Rod Ngern Sod Than Jai' means 'Your car and/or your home can bring you instant cash.'
deep_cut_fact: He earned his undergraduate degree from Sukhothai Thammathirat Open University, Thailand's distance-learning public university.
notes: No published IR email located (Srisawad IR site did not load from here); company IR department is listed on SEC Thailand profile https://market.sec.or.th/public/idisc/en/companyprofile/listed/SAWAD. Low English-language media profile.

name: Chen Qiong
current_role: Director and Deputy General Manager, Sirio Pharma Co., Ltd. (仙乐健康, SZSE: 300791), Shantou
profile: Chen Qiong (b. 1966) and her husband Lin Peiqing are the actual controllers of Sirio Pharma, together holding ~46% of the Shantou-based contract maker of nutrition and health products. The firm began as a drug maker in the early 1990s and pivoted to nutraceuticals after 2000; it calls itself the world's No.2 gummy and softgel solutions provider, earns 60%+ of revenue abroad and filed for a Hong Kong listing in Jan 2026.
interesting_fact: Sirio ranks third globally in nutrition-and-health-food solutions by 2024 revenue, and is building a plant in Thailand (due 2027) with planned capacity of 2.4 billion gummies a year.
deep_cut_fact: A pharmacist by training (master's degree), she started as a formulation researcher at the research institute of the Tuobin pharmaceutical factory in Shantou, then was quality head at Shantou Meiji Pharmaceutical before co-running Sirio.
notes: Wealth shared with husband Lin Peiqing (chairman/GM), who is the public face of the company. IR email is the board secretary's office per the 2025 annual report. Low personal media profile.
